prerequisite: Completed DEV-046B three-seed checkpoint and physical audit; use joint_trainable by advance specification, not evaluation selection

train.frozen: observation, memory and action-conditioned OSM; only relevance score trains

fallbacks.exact: public event-queue controller on unselected entities, full history scan timed and counted
fallbacks.inspect: charged public inspections on unselected entities, verified local state update then additional OSM calls
fallbacks.review: unselected actions remain HUMAN_REVIEW; incomplete coverage has no invented total physical cost

verification: All executable policies acquire and pay for a post-horizon inspection per entity. Trusted receipts update state even when forecasts disagree. Invalid/rejected receipts cannot write state.
selection: Development-only Pareto archive over failures, physical cost and measured runtime; choose complete-coverage zero-failure candidate with minimum development cost, then predicted positions, then name. Freeze choice before generating evaluation.
optimizer_scope: Deterministic trace/candidate search and Pareto archive, not an implementation or empirical validation of GEPA's LLM reflection algorithm
metrics: cost including fallback and verifier sensing
audit: same raw public worlds per candidate
partial coverage never wins on missing costs
limitations: sparse OSM does not imply constant total runtime
no sealed confirmation or integrated architecture superiority claim
external GEPA reflection and real digital twin validation remain separate future studies
